name: UGC 12295, SN 2015ah field (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 12295, a galaxy that hosted the supernova SN 2015ah, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2015ah-hubble
story: In this galaxy the supernova SN 2015ah went off, its early spectrum read by one team as a peculiar Type Ib and by another as Type IIb. Hubble came back years later to image the site of the blast.

claims.text: One team's spectrum showed a peculiar Type Ib supernova; another found features suggesting Type IIb
Hubble program 16024 imaged the site of SN 2015ah, part of a snapshot survey of the sites of recent, nearby supernovae
